[[File:13w17a debug.stitched terrain.png|thumb|debug.stitched_terrain.png in [[13w17a]], the last version to actually use this file.]]

'''<samp>stitched_terrain.png</samp>''' was a [[texture atlas]] generated by the game in [[.minecraft]], comprised of the game's block textures.

Whether it was actually used for block textures is unknown, as it can be removed from .minecraft at runtime seemingly without affecting the game. In addition, a sister atlas, <samp>[[stitched_items.png]]</samp>, has several invisible pixels shown at full intensity. As such, this atlas may just be a debugging byproduct - more information is needed on this matter. Its renaming to <samp>debug.stitched_terrain.png</samp> in 13w09a further supports this theory.
